request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, gentle percussion, nostalgic and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
These were the sons of Israel
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah
Issachar, Zebulun, Dan
Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali
Gad, and Asher stood as one
Judah had five sons in all
Er, Onan, and Shelah there
Tamar bore Perez and Zerah

[Chorus]
Eleasah fathered Sismai
And Sismai fathered Shallum
Sismai fathered Shallum
A line of Judah's name

[Verse]
Jerahmeel, Hezron's firstborn
Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem
Ahijah joined in the tree
Ram, his firstborn, sired more
Maaz, Jamin, and Eker
Sheshan had no sons at all
Only daughters in his house
He gave his daughter to Jarha

[Chorus]
Eleasah fathered Sismai
And Sismai fathered Shallum
Sismai fathered Shallum
A line of Judah's name

[Bridge]
Attai fathered Nathan then
Nathan fathered Zabad's son
Zabad sired Ephlal, yes
Ephlal sired Obed's line
Obed sired Jehu, then
Jehu sired Azariah
Azariah sired Helez
Helez sired Eleasah

[Outro]
Eleasah fathered Sismai
And Sismai fathered Shallum
